# Doppel 1.1.6
- Brings an instance to the front when its ChatGPT profile is already open in another ChatGPT window, instead of bouncing in the Dock and opening nothing. This affected an instance that shares ChatGPT's own profile folder: the official app claims that profile as soon as it starts, so the instance could never take it and quit again a moment after the click. Clicking its icon now raises the window that actually has the profile.

# Doppel 1.1.5
- Names the app that is holding the built-in browser engine. When ChatGPT is running on its own, outside Doppel, the Native Tools section said a profile called "701" was running, which was the process ID rather than a name.

# Doppel 1.1.4
- Rebuilds instances again on ChatGPT 26.818 and later. The previous version could not patch the newest ChatGPT layout, so instances failed with "Patching the instance OAuth callback routing failed" and would not start. - Recognises the reworked deep-link handling in current ChatGPT builds without pinning to one release, so a routine ChatGPT update no longer strands your instances.
